_meta.notes: The cleanest filing in the Noyce series — every figure reconciles both within the page (1,403.42 + 12,985.78 = 14,389.20; minus 12,087.73 = 2,301.47) and against the April report (5,695.75 + 12,985.78 = 18,681.53 Column B; 4,292.33 + 12,087.73 = 16,380.06 Column B; 18,681.53 - 16,380.06 = 2,301.47). The top-row Office field reads 'S.L. County Council Dist 1' with '(sought)' written above. Stamped RECEIVED JUN 15 2010.

contributions.detail: exact (12985.78 = 12985.78); 50 rows across 4 Schedule A pages, every page subtotal closing and the sum of the four subtotals equalling the printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED 12,985.78 and Summary line 1

expenditures.detail: exact (12087.73 = 12087.73); 34 rows across 3 Schedule B pages, every page subtotal closing and the sum of the three subtotals equalling the printed TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE 12,087.73 and Summary line 2

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: ALL SEVEN PAGE GATES FIRED. p3 rows 3,910.00 = printed subtotal 3,910.00; p4 rows 5,455.00 = 5,455.00; p5 rows 3,225.00 = 3,225.00; p6 rows 395.78 = printed subtotal (see below); p7 rows 4,631.70 = 4,631.70; p8 rows 7,200.36 = 7,200.36; p9 rows 255.67 = 255.67. Sum-of-subtotals gates also fired: 3910.00+5455.00+3225.00+395.78 = 12,985.78 = printed TOTAL; 4631.70+7200.36+255.67 = 12,087.73 = printed TOTAL. *** p6 SUBTOTAL, A DIGIT ADJUDICATED BY ARITHMETIC: the leading glyph of that cell is degraded and at both 200 dpi and a 900 dpi cell crop it looks more like a 2 than a 3 ('295.78'). TWO INDEPENDENT IDENTITIES require 3: the page's own five rows sum to 395.78, and the four subtotals only reach the printed TOTAL 12,985.78 (which itself equals Summary line 1) if this page is 395.78. The document's arithmetic is taken over the glyph re-read, per the standing rule, and the ambiguity is recorded here rather than hidden.
itemized.escalation_note: p6 SUBTOTAL cell at 900 dpi (leading digit still reads as a broken 2/3 - not resolved by resolution, resolved by the two arithmetic identities above); p4 row 3 DATE cell at 900 dpi (leading digit is a broken stroke; recorded 2010-05-05 at low confidence with needs_review, since no identity constrains a date).
itemized.notes: 9-page filing, standard order and complete: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page (totals tranche, not redone), p3-p6 Schedule A pages numbered 2/8 through 5/8 by the filer, p7-p9 Schedule B pages 6/8 through 8/8. Every schedule page is headed 'Noyce' with Date of Report 6/15/10. PRIVACY / ADDRESS: the Complete Mailing Address column is blank on all four Schedule A pages, with faint residual ink visible only at the extreme top and bottom edges of the column - consistent with a mask laid over that column; no city or state is readable for any contributor, so donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout. Cents are written as raised superscripts over a rule on the Schedule A pages and are transcribed with a decimal point. THREE IN-KIND transactions appear on BOTH schedules (X-Mission web hosting, 4/11, 5/11 and 6/11, $35.00 each, marked '(in-kind)' in the amount cell on both sides) and they count inside the printed totals on both sides. Two rows are aggregates with no donor: Schedule A p6 'Cash Contributions Under 50.00' ($125.78, no date printed). Two rows involve the candidate's own household or person: 'Verma Noyce' (contribution) and 'Cal Noyce' (expenditure reimbursement). Schedule B p8 row 11 has an earlier recipient name heavily struck out and overwritten - the strike-out is unreadable and was not guessed. The pre-printed form's own typo 'TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE' appears on every Schedule B page.
